facts.text: Bukhara was an important Silk Road city.
The Ferghana Valley lies in the country’s east.

culture.text: Traditional round breads, including Samarkand’s obi-non, are baked in clay ovens and accompany meals.

food.name: Plov
food.text: Rice, carrots, onion, and meat form this dish, with ingredients and methods varying by region.
